product_one_liner.value: Fly.io is a public cloud for developers and teams building apps and AI agents, providing hardware-isolated Linux virtual machines, agent sandboxes, and managed PostgreSQL.

eng_blog.notes: Chris McCord explains building Phoenix.new at Fly.io; SRE Will Jordan explains the platform’s micro-VM/serverless architecture.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current board lists Platform Security Engineer, Fullstack Engineer, Infrastructure Operations Engineer, and Networking Engineer: Proxy and Corrosion. None has a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title; AI-related responsibilities alone do not qualify.

model_provider.notes: Fly.io’s Connectors product provides model access through a customer-supplied OpenRouter key and an OpenAI-compatible endpoint; this does not establish OpenAI as the underlying model provider. Separately, the subprocessor list identifies Anthropic and OpenAI for internal tooling, not customer application inference.

compliance_certs.notes: Publicly claims completed SOC 2 Type 2. HIPAA BAA availability is not a certification; datacenter ISO 27001 certifications are not Fly.io’s own.

raised_18mo.notes: The July 24, 2026 Series D falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No qualifying SDR, BDR, or account executive title is listed. A separate Strategic Accounts Account Manager posting does not qualify.

launched_6mo.notes: Managed Postgres v2 beta was announced May 19, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026; it moves the service onto Fly Machines and Fly networking.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On July 24, 2026, Fly.io announced Scott Johnston had joined as CEO; founder Kurt Mackey transitioned to an advisory role while retaining his board seat.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The public subprocessor list identifies HubSpot and Snowflake for customer relationship management, and Customer.io for newsletters and transactional email.
